reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "New CRD `managedresourceactivationpolicies.apiextensions.crossplane.io` (ManagedResourceActivationPolicy, v1alpha1)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: The new ManagedResourceActivationPolicy CRD must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release; failure to do so will cause resources using this API to be rejected.

proposed.statement: A new CRD ManagedResourceActivationPolicy (managedresourceactivationpolicies.apiextensions.crossplane.io, v1alpha1) is added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.
